# Журнал DRESS

> > Russian fashion magazine covering haute couture, Paris Fashion Week, celebrity style, and expert fashion consultations.

DRESS Magazine (dress-mag.com) is a Russian-language fashion publication featuring coverage of international haute couture collections from brands like Chanel, Dior, and Schiaparelli, red carpet analysis, and personalized stylist consultations. The magazine collaborates with fashion experts including Karina Ostrovskaya and partners with FORWARD by Viner.

## Fashion News & Runway Coverage

- [Открытие Недели моды Paris Haute Couture Week](https://dress-mag.com/news/parizhe-startovala-nedelya-vysokoy-mody): Paris Haute Couture Week opening: Dior, Schiaparelli, Iris van Herpen
- [Коллекция Haute Couture от Chanel лето 2024](https://dress-mag.com/news/haute-couture-chanel-leto-2024): Chanel Summer 2024 Haute Couture collection with ballet theme by Viard
- [Мода с красной дорожки премии Оскар](https://dress-mag.com/news/luchshie-platya-tseremonii-vrucheniya-oskar): 15 best dresses from 95th Oscars 2023 red carpet featuring Michelle Yeoh
